response:
This sounds incredibly painful—you're carrying the grief of losing your child alongside the fear of losing your marriage, and this time of year clearly reopens deep wounds for both of you.

It's a hopeful sign that she agreed to come back and said she hopes you can do the work. That gives you both something to build on. As you move forward, it might help to be honest with yourself about what "give me a little time" means and what changes she's hoping to see. Couples counseling, and grief counseling around your child, could give you real support instead of just returning to the cycle you describe. You mentioned forgiving the cheating "if she'll come home"—it's worth sitting with whether that forgiveness is genuine or a way to avoid losing her, because unresolved resentment tends to resurface.

You've been through more than most people can imagine. Talking with a counselor of your own could help you carry some of this weight. You deserve that support too.
